response.sql: WITH college_counts AS (SELECT pc.college_id, COUNT(*) AS attendance_count FROM player_college AS pc GROUP BY pc.college_id), matched_colleges AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(c.state), ''), '') AS state, cc.attendance_count FROM college_counts AS cc JOIN college AS c ON c.college_id = cc.college_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(attendance_count) AS avg_count, SUM(attendance_count) AS total_count FROM matched_colleges) SELECT mc.state, AVG(mc.attendance_count) AS avg_college_count, AVG(1.0 * mc.attendance_count / o.avg_count) AS avg_relative_to_overall_average, AVG(1.0 * mc.attendance_count / o.total_count) AS avg_share_of_total FROM matched_colleges AS mc CROSS JOIN overall AS o GROUP BY mc.state
